title: Stage-3 mechanical convention-conformance gate outcome (bank health)
description: The versioned machine-readable verdict emitted by conformance_gate.evaluate_task for one edit task: do the task's AUTHORED exemplar anchors still conform in the forged tree? This measures the BANK's material, not an agent's work -- the runtime convention verdict is conformance_gate_v2 (see $defs.run_outcome), which carries this as its bank_health field alongside the agent-patch verdict. Deterministic and byte-stable: anchors are ordered by (path, lines) and reason codes are drawn from a stable enum. FAILS CLOSED -- any abnormal condition (malformed/missing/decoy/non-live anchor, stale bound, absent identifier, ambiguous or absent structural match, malformed/unsupported rule, tool failure) yields passed=false with the exact reason code.

rule_id.description: The convention rule id; null when the rule was malformed.

kind.description: The structural handler family that judged the rule; null when unsupported/malformed.

passed.description: True only when every anchor conforms.

diagnostic.description: Human-readable summary; leads with the first failing reason code.

reason.description: Stable reason-code enum shared by the bank-health and agent-patch verdicts. CONFORMS and PATCH_CONFORMS are the only passing codes; every other code is a fail-closed condition.

run_outcome.description: conformance_gate_v2 -- the RUNTIME convention verdict for one edit attempt, emitted by conformance_gate.evaluate_run. Two components, neither merged into the other: agent_patch answers the question the headline metric asks (did the AGENT's changed regions honour the rule?), bank_health answers whether the material that judgement rests on is sound. passed requires both, so a verdict measured with defective exemplars fails closed while keeping ANCHOR_*/RULE_* reason codes that charge the failure to the harness rather than the agent.

agent_patch_outcome.description: conformance_agent_patch_v1 -- the verdict on the AGENT's changed regions. Candidate constructs are detected structurally over the patched text and judged when their own span intersects a line the agent changed, so an unrelated edit yields PATCH_UNGOVERNED (fail closed, the convention claim is unproven) rather than a free pass. Never compiles the task's authored conforms_pattern.

passed.description: True only when at least one governed construct was touched and every touched construct conforms.

regions.description: One entry per TOUCHED governed construct, in (path, offset) order.

lines.description: The anchor's line bound as authored. Echoed back verbatim so a fail-closed verdict names the exact defective bound; only ANCHOR_MALFORMED / ANCHOR_BOUND_STALE outcomes may carry an empty or non-positive bound.

evidence.description: The matched conforming construct, or '' when none matched.
